claim: Rule 3(a): application fee Rs 10, by cash against proper receipt, demand draft, banker's cheque payable to the public authority, or by affixing a Rs 10 court fee stamp.

Rule 3(b): a request shall relate to one subject matter and shall not ordinarily exceed 150 words. Where a request covers more than one subject matter the PIO may respond to the first only and advise separate applications.
notes: Material divergence from the Union route. Bundled requests are lawfully answerable in part only. Draft Maharashtra applications singly.

claim: Rule 4(1)(A): Rs 2 per A-4 or A-3 page plus postal charges; larger paper at actual or cost price plus postage; where a price is already fixed for a document or map, that price plus postage. No postal charge if collected in person.

Rule 4(1)(B): inspection of records free for the first hour, then Rs 5 per fifteen minutes or part. Rule 3(c): inspection in the presence of the PIO or authorised representative, during office hours, pencil only, other writing instruments to be deposited, no marking on the record.

Rule 5(1): first appeal within thirty days of receipt of the SPIO's order, Annexure B format, fee Rs 20 or Rs 20 court fee stamp, with a copy of the order appealed against. Rule 5(2): second appeal to the State Information Commission within ninety days of receipt of the appellate authority's order, Annexure C format, fee Rs 20.
